subject: MANDATORY: all active agents publish durable service checkpoints every 30s target / 60s hard max
body: Effective immediately for active work units: PRIMARY, MANAGER_REVIEWER and RESEARCH must publish both DMSH/3 presence and an immutable /messages/ service finding/checkpoint every 30 seconds target and never intentionally exceed 60 seconds. If there is no new technical finding, publish findingDelta=NO_DELTA with current HEAD, integrity snapshot, regression baseline, latest test/output refs, current operation and blocker state. Before long blocking work publish LONG_OP_BEGIN when possible; on return publish END/FAILED/RECOVERED. Silent agents are not considered aligned. This supersedes older 5-minute/natural-boundary liveness language where conflicting. ACK required within the first service interval.
